Snowflake OpenFlow

sections.scope_of_work: Develop and validate a Proof of Concept (PoC) for Snowflake OpenFlow as a replacement for Azure Data Factory (ADF). Upon successful validation, migrate approved data pipelines from SharePoint, APIs, Cosmos DB, and OData sources into Snowflake OpenFlow. The engagement includes pipeline development, migration, testing, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and production support to establish a scalable enterprise data integration platform.
